in_marathi.name: Akshaj
in_marathi.long_meaning: Akshaj हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Akshaj is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Aksh' which means 'Eye' and 'J' which means 'Immortal'. In Hindu mythology, Akshaj is believed to represent the imperishable and indestructible divine eye that bestows wisdom and knowledge. The name is also associated with Lord Shiva, who is revered as the destroyer and the protector.
